hito_summary: Multiprosposito - Domain Pack de software + narrativo, tipos extensibles declarativamente sin modificar nucleo
criteria_observed: test_pack_loader_declares_types_from_narrative_pack: pack narrativo declara Character/StoryArc desde YAML
test_pack_loader_valid_character_passes: instancia valida de Character se acepta (name, archetype, backstory, relations)
test_pack_loader_valid_storyarc_passes: instancia valida de StoryArc se acepta (title, premise, acts, characters)
test_pack_loader_character_missing_archetype_fails: campo requerido ausente -> error de validacion
test_pack_loader_storyarc_missing_premise_fails: campo requerido ausente -> error de validacion
test_pack_loader_cannot_shadow_core_type: 'Character' no puede redefinir DecisionNode/ActionNode/DomainPack (no shadowing)
test_pack_loader_rejects_non_domain_pack: doc sin frontmatter Domain Pack -> error
test_pack_loader_does_not_touch_kernel_modules: pack_loader NO importa registry/bricks/parser (test de regresion)

design_decisions.no_execution: pack_loader SOLO declara tipos a partir del schema declarativo. NO ejecuta codigo del pack. La seguridad viene del schema, no de imports dinamicos.
design_decisions.schema_validator: SpecValidator se construye en runtime desde {required, fields: {name: {type, required, list_of, ref}}}.
design_decisions.shadowing_protection: Tipos core (DecisionNode, ActionNode, DomainPack) y namespaces reservados (core, skillgraph) no se pueden redefinir.
design_decisions.explicit_imports: Los imports son estaticos (no exec/importlib), pack_loader no toca kernel.
